issues: 画面左上角打着卡名大写 "FLIP GRID REFLOW"，是调试占位标题
没有导出时长常量，工作台默认 150f，比本意多 5f
横排放在 y=330 屏心偏上，开场 1 秒下半屏全空，构图失衡
卡片飞行时阴影不变、无运动模糊，像平面贴图在滑；重排没有界面上的触发理由
落定后整屏 brightness 0.78 压暗，读作闪屏；背景是平灰
changes: 补 FLIP_GRID_REFLOW_DURATION = 145（静止 30f + 飞行 27f + 脉冲 + 真静止 81f）；节拍 30、错峰 1.5f、16f inOut cubic、1.28 + 1.02 过冲、网格坐标全部不变
调试标题换成页面头："Projects" 60px + "6 active · updated just now" 32px + Row/Grid 视图切换器，滑块比卡片起飞早 2f 同拍滑到 Grid，给重排一个界面上的因
横排挪到 y=540 与网格同心，上下两排轨迹对称展开（md 坐标表同步）
飞行中卡片沿正弦弧抬升：两层软阴影离地 4→34→4px 变大变虚，飞行中的卡置顶；按速度挂方向性 SpeedBlur（封顶 12px）
收束脉冲只压卡片层、谷值 0.86（md 同步）；背景换柔光 Backdrop + 极淡强调色余光 + 暗角
issuesEn: The card name 'FLIP GRID REFLOW' was printed in caps at top left as a debug placeholder title
No exported duration; the workbench defaulted to 150f, 5f longer than intended
The row sat at y=330, above centre, leaving the bottom half empty for the first second
Cards kept the same shadow and had no motion blur in flight, sliding like flat stickers, and nothing in the UI motivated the reflow
After landing, the whole frame dipped to brightness 0.78, reading as a flicker; the background was flat grey
changesEn: Added FLIP_GRID_REFLOW_DURATION = 145 (30f still + 27f flight + pulse + 81f true hold); beat 30, 1.5f stagger, 16f inOut cubic, 1.28 scale with 1.02 overshoot and grid coordinates all unchanged

Replaced the debug title with a page header: 'Projects' at 60px, '6 active · updated just now' at 32px, and a Row/Grid view switch whose thumb slides to Grid 2f before the cards take off, giving the reflow a cause in the UI
Moved the row to y=540, concentric with the grid, so the two rows split symmetrically (card coordinate table updated)
Cards lift along a sine arc in flight: a two-layer soft shadow grows and softens from 4→34→4px, flying cards render on top, and velocity-driven SpeedBlur is applied (capped at 12px)
The settle pulse now darkens only the card layer, to 0.86 (card updated); the background is a soft-light Backdrop with a faint accent tint and vignette
